posts.caption: 5 dumbbell moves that torched my shoulders in 15 minutes 🔥 no gym needed
posts.creator: @liftwithlena
summary: Superset lateral raises with front raises to hit all three deltoid heads
Keep reps slow (3-sec lower) to maximize time under tension
Only need a single pair of adjustable dumbbells, 15 minutes total
Finish with a 45-second plank hold to fry the core too
Do this 2x/week alongside push day for visible shoulder cap growth

Bulgarian split squats fix left/right strength imbalances
Hip thrusts at the end maximize glute activation when quads are pre-fatigued
Rest 2-3 minutes between heavy compound sets

posts.caption: Core finisher you can do after literally any workout — 6 min, no equipment
posts.creator: @corebydani
summary: Circuit of 4 moves, 40 seconds on / 20 off, repeat twice
Hollow hold builds the anti-extension core strength most people skip
Bicycle crunches target obliques for that rotational strength
No equipment, works anywhere — tack onto the end of any session

posts.caption: Creamy garlic butter tuscan shrimp — 20 minutes, one pan, unreal
posts.creator: @pastaqueen
summary: One pan, ready in 20 minutes — perfect for weeknights
Sun-dried tomatoes and parmesan build the creamy sauce base
Sear shrimp first and set aside so they don't overcook
Serve over pasta, rice, or crusty bread to soak up the sauce
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes to taste
steps: Season shrimp with salt and pepper, sear in butter 2 min per side, remove from pan
Add garlic and sun-dried tomatoes to the same pan, saute 1 minute
Pour in heavy cream, bring to a simmer, whisk in parmesan until smooth
Stir in spinach until wilted, then return shrimp to the pan
Simmer 2 minutes until shrimp is warmed through, serve immediately

posts.caption: The crispiest smashed potatoes you'll ever make (recipe below)
posts.creator: @homecookhaley
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water until fork-tender, about 15 minutes
Drain and let steam-dry for 5 minutes
Smash each potato flat with the bottom of a glass on a baking sheet
Drizzle with olive oil, season with garlic powder, paprika, and salt
Roast at 450F for 25-30 minutes until deeply golden and crispy
Top with flaky salt and chives before serving

posts.caption: 5-ingredient banana oat pancakes — my Sunday morning staple
posts.creator: @fitfoodfaye
summary: Only 5 ingredients, all blended together — no flour needed
Ripe bananas add natural sweetness so no sugar required
Rolled oats blended into flour keep these gluten-friendly
Cook low and slow so the centers set without burning the outside
steps: Blend all ingredients together until smooth batter forms
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat with a little butter
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake, cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form
Flip and cook another 2 minutes until golden
Serve with maple syrup and fresh berries

posts.caption: One-pot chicken tikka masala that tastes better than takeout
posts.creator: @spiceroute_sam
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the spice blend for at least 30 minutes
Sear marinated chicken in a hot pot until browned, set aside
Saute onion, garlic, and ginger until soft, add remaining spices
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes to deepen flavor
Stir in cream and return chicken to the pot, simmer 15 minutes
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan

posts.caption: Meal-prepped Mediterranean bowls for the whole week
posts.creator: @fitfoodfaye
steps: Divide quinoa evenly between 5 meal-prep containers
Layer cucumber, tomatoes, olives, and feta on top
Add sliced grilled chicken to each container
Store vinaigrette separately and dress right before eating
Keeps fresh in the fridge for up to 4 days

Two full days is enough if you cluster temples by neighborhood
